title.hr: Yagi antena: reflektor, direktori i inducirane struje
title.en: The Yagi: a reflector, directors, and parasitic currents

concept.hr: Napaja se samo zračitelj; ostali nose inducirane struje, faze im daje duljina
concept.en: Only one element is fed; the others carry induced currents phased by length

summary.hr: Dodaj direktore, mijenjaj duljine i razmake: inducirane struje (iznos i faza), dijagram zračenja, dobitak, omjer naprijed-natrag i impedancija napajanja.
summary.en: Add directors, change lengths and spacings: the induced currents (size and phase), the pattern, the gain, the front-to-back ratio and the feed impedance.
